execution_boundary.source: existing P5 cached train/validation outputs only

dense_cosine.confound: image/text encoders differ in training, capacity, and representation dimension

analysis.threshold_rule: frozen deterministic P6 minimax rule on train; unchanged evaluation on validation

retain_as_core_outcome_a_requires: at least one paired comparison has a strictly positive lower 95% family-bootstrap bound for image-minus-text improvement in same-minus-near gap
the same comparison has same-minus-random image-minus-text lower bound >= -0.02
its validation minimax worst error is at least 0.10 lower for image than text
if structured, image macro atom F1 is no lower than text macro atom F1
benefit is attributable enough to the image pathway to justify added compute, storage, and privacy exposure
material_benefit_rule.unresolved_outcome_c_requires: required cached artifacts are missing/incompatible, or every available comparison is incapable of answering the transformation question because no downstream matcher is comparable
material_benefit_rule.otherwise: outcome B: make image optional, reposition it as a measurement baseline, or remove it from the authentication core

semantic_policy_boundary: mandatory-anchor plus tolerant-attribute matching may be recorded only as a future hypothesis; no P7 implementation or tuning; any test requires a new version, independent rationale, new data, preregistration, and gate
